title: Alex, your former peer, wants to talk.
lessonTitle: How to Set Boundaries With Former Peers

checklistItems.label: Acknowledged Alex without agreeing to repeat the old habit
Made clear the slides and demo prep are Alex's to own
Did not agree to redo or polish Alex's slides for him
Stayed calm when Alex pushed back about launch
Said how Alex should ask and send work next time
Offered help that doesn't do the work (review, dry run, structure)

scenarioSummary.now: Tomorrow ~10am product review: a few of Alex's slides in the shared deck aren't ready.
scenarioSummary.past: At launch, learner cleaned up Alex's slides/demo; unspoken habit.
scenarioSummary.ask: Polish Alex's slides tonight; Alex still presents.
